description: Purpose: search the rCB technology and standards library - ASTM D36 committee series (D8178 / D8466 / D8474 /D8632 / D1618 / D1506 / D8491 / D8585), Chinese standards (HG/T 5459 / GB/T 40009 / GB/T 19208 / GB/T 13460 /GB/T 3782 / T/CTRA 01), continuous pyrolysis processes, rCB post-treatment and sustainable carbon black.Guidelines: combine keyword with category (terminology / test / product / process / traceability) and region; use verified=true to keep only entries backed by standard texts. Limits: standard summaries and key technical parameters only - full standard text is never reproduced; C-grade entries are unverified leads; the category taxonomy is ours, not the issuing body's. Ex: query_techs(keyword='TGA'), query_techs(category='测试标准'), query_techs(keyword='ASTM', language='en').

category.description: 类别过滤，如 '术语标准'、'测试标准'、'产品标准'、'工艺技术'、'追溯标准'

confidence.description: 置信度：A=官方标准原文核实, B=权威二手来源, C=待核实

keyword.description: 关键词模糊匹配，如 'ASTM'、'TGA'、'GB/T'、'热裂解'、'分类'

limit.description: 返回条数上限（默认 20，最大 100）

region.description: 地区/组织过滤，如 '国际'、'中国'、'欧盟'、'ASTM'

response_format.description: 输出格式：markdown=人类阅读, json=Agent 处理友好

verified.description: true=只看 A 级已核实条目

name: query_techs

text.description: Human-readable result (markdown, or a JSON string when response_format=json).

title: Search Standards & Technologies
